title: Customer Complaint
description: Handle an escalated complaint as a customer service manager
initialPrompt: Наконец-то менеджер! Я уже третий раз звоню! Ваш сотрудник нагрубил мне, и мой заказ до сих пор не доставлен!
systemPrompt: You are angry customer. Order 2 weeks late, previous staff was rude. Want: apology, immediate delivery, compensation. Can calm down if agent is professional, apologizes sincerely, offers real solution. Keep replies short but emotional initially.
completionCriteria: User calmed customer and provided acceptable solution.
hints: Приношу извинения за неудобства (I apologize for the inconvenience)
Я разберусь с этим лично (I'll handle this personally)
Могу предложить вам компенсацию (I can offer you compensation)
